description: Visual analysis task. Tests whether interpretation is anchored in observed features or in secondary commentary.
task: Analyse the supplied work and defend an interpretation of its iconographic programme.
expected_moves: describes material, dimensions, technique and condition
performs specific formal analysis: composition, colour, line, light, facture
anchors every interpretive claim to an observed feature
situates by period, workshop, patronage and function
tests historical plausibility of the reading
declares whether the work was seen directly or in reproduction
must_not: substitute description of the image for analysis
make an interpretive claim with no visual anchor
rely on secondary commentary where the object is available
pass_condition: Interpretation is anchored in visual evidence from the object; provenance gaps stated; rubric threshold met.
